question:
Read the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f6716f55b38d36fb1e76506f07d75330ea2f948c8a81d54fe4f2258cb409f6.png]
solution:
The logic follows here:

Upper side term (1st term × 2nd term) ÷ 2 - 1 = 1st term lower side

Upper side term (2nd term × 3rd term) ÷ 2 - 1 = 2nd term lower side

And so on.

1st term lower side = (4 × 4) ÷ 2 - 1 = 16 ÷ 2 - 1 = 8 - 1 = 7

2nd term lower side = (4 × 2) ÷ 2 - 1 = 8 ÷ 2 - 1 = 4 - 1 = 3

**3rd term lower side = (2 × 9) ÷ 2 - 1 = 18 ÷ 2 - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8**

4th term lower side = (9 × 4) ÷ 2 - 1 = 36 ÷ 2 - 1 = 18 - 1 = 17

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".**
